comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
Uhoh, another angry dude on a lonely Saturday night :D

Don't mind these guys, they A. don't know where exactly to get it so can't answer your question exactly and B. assume everybody that reads ivyro does so daily and knows exactly what event/nc shop/etc means.

I don't know what event exactly it would have been from but event means a special event that occurred in game like the recent one where Justine sends you places to collect guests for the party or whatever. At the end of each 'round' you received a reward item.

As for NC Shop that means it could also have been an NC (paid) item at one time, or in the treasure box either directly or from a ticket.

As for etc, no idea.

So in short, you probably cannot get it from any regular in game method such as shipwrecks, stores, plundering etc. Maybe somebody more knowledgeable and less angry will come along that knows better than 'Mei Hua' and I.
